summary: Frontend-only regression test of the period default fix. Verified PeriodProvider now defaults year/month to real system date (September 2026, matches container `date`) after login for both koordinator (raihan) and petugas (kalgen). Year dropdown includes current year 2026 plus 2027 from DB. Month switching (to Juli) still reloads data. After logout + re-login, period resets to real current date (not sticky to previously selected Juli). Dashboard KPIs populate correctly for September 2026 (Total 96, Kritis 12, Waspada 15, Aman 65, Perlu Cek 4). All tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: PeriodProvider correctly uses new Date() for initial state; useEffect no longer overrides year/month. Clean fix.
AppShell PeriodSelector uses Set(periods.map(p=>p.year)) + currentYear + current year state, sorted desc. Correctly ensures selected year always appears as an option.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Period default fix verified working. Container real date at test time was 2026-09-03 12:20 UTC, and app defaulted to September 2026 correctly after fresh login for both roles. Year dropdown correctly includes 2026 (current) and 2027 (existing DB periods). Logout/re-login correctly re-defaults to current period each time (PeriodProvider remounts via Gate).
